questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1) All games are tournaments.

2) Some tournaments are matches.

**Conclusions:**

I. All games are matches.

II. No game is a tournament.

options.text: Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
Both Conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/832576d3dc07153f8855b450020357bdb58c9a93f002a271d2f3962c85e9b91e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All games are matches → Does not follow (As all games are tournaments and some tournaments are matches. So it is possible but not definite.)

II. No game is a tournament → Does not follow (As all games are tournaments. As whole games comes in tournament, therefore, game can not be tournament is false.)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows"

questions.question:
Two Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All blues are reds.

All greens are blues.

**Conclusions:**

I. No red is a blue.

II. No blue is a green.

III. No green is a red.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/070103449d6da45ccb0f24854b15651ce695388c9b11fa233eb464eaa0fbfc55.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No red is a blue → Does not follow (As all blues are reds. So whole blues comes in red, therefore, no red is blue is false.)

II. No blue is a green → Does not follow (As all greens are blues. So whole greens comes in blue, therefore, no blue is green is false.)

III. No red is a green → Does not follow (As all blues are reds and all greens are blues. So whole greens comes in blue which whole comes in red, therefore, no red is green is false.)

∴ Here, None of the conclusions follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**None of the conclusions follow**"

questions.question:
If + means − , − means × , × means ÷ , ÷ means +, what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the given equation?

180 × 60 – 30 ÷ 30 + 20 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 180 × 60 – 30 ÷ 30 + 20 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 -
 ×
 ÷
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ __**180 ÷ 60**__ × 30 + 30 - 20 = ?

⇒ __**3 × 30**__ + 30 - 20 = ?

⇒ __**90 + 30**__ - 20 = ?

⇒ __**120**__ - 20 = **100**.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".
